source:
Imagine a fashion game called Runway Royale. It has the fun of creating outfits and competing in fashion shows, but with much more to do between rounds.
🌟 Main Lobby
As players join, they enter a huge luxury fashion mall with glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, music, and a spinning central runway. Around the lobby are portals to different game modes, a daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, and event stage.
👗 Dressing Booths
Instead of everyone changing in the open, every player gets their own private dressing booth.
Full-length smart mirrors
Outfit save slots
Makeup and hair stations
Skin tone and body customization
Accessory organizers
Outfit randomizer
Favorite clothing section
Booth themes you can unlock (Fairy, Modern, Princess, Cyber, Beach, Cottagecore, etc.)
🛍️ Non-VIP Fashion Area
Everyone can use hundreds of beautiful items including:
Dresses
Jeans
Skirts
Jackets
Hoodies
Sneakers
Heels
Boots
Hats
Glasses
Hairstyles
Makeup
Jewelry
Bags
Nails
Face accessories
New free clothes are added every week so non-VIP players never feel left behind.
💎 VIP Fashion Lounge
VIP players enter through sparkling golden doors into a luxury boutique.
VIP includes:
Exclusive designer collections
Animated dresses
Wings
Luxury gowns
Fantasy outfits
Premium hairstyles
Designer handbags
Exclusive makeup
Particle effects
Glowing accessories
Special poses
VIP-only dressing booths
Private runway practice room
VIP chat lounge
🎭 Fashion Themes
Every round gives a random theme, such as:
Mermaid Royalty
First Day of School
Pop Star
Vampire Queen
Winter Wonderland
Space Explorer
Cottage Princess
Y2K
Gothic Glam
Red Carpet
Fairy Forest
Pirate Captain
Summer Vacation
Magical Academy
Celebrity Look
Players have 5 minutes to create their outfits.
✨ Runway Show
When time is up:
Players walk down a stunning animated runway.
Spotlights follow each model.
Cameras flash.
Music changes with each round.
Players strike poses before reaching the judges.
⭐ Voting
Instead of simple stars, players earn points for:
Creativity
Theme accuracy
Styling
Color coordination
Overall wow factor
The top three receive crowns, confetti, and bonus rewards.
🏆 Progression
Players level up through fashion ranks:
Fashion Rookie
Trendsetter
Style Icon
Elite Designer
Supermodel
Fashion Legend
Runway Royalty
Higher ranks unlock badges, titles, booth decorations, and special victory animations.
📸 Extra Features
Outfit photo studio
Trading accessories
Fashion clubs with friends
Weekly tournaments
Seasonal battle pass
Daily styling challenges
Pet companions
Color wheel with millions of shades
Fabric textures (silk, denim, velvet, lace, leather)
Weather effects on runways
Fashion magazine where winning outfits are displayed
🌈 Why it stands out
Instead of only dressing up and voting, players can collect rare clothing, decorate their own dressing booth, climb fashion leagues, complete quests, trade cosmetics, join fashion teams, and explore a beautiful world that keeps growing with new updates. It feels like a fashion-themed adventure rather than just a runway game, making it deeper and more rewarding while staying fun for casual players.

answers.ask: Is the mall lobby, the runway and the VIP wing all one continuous space, or does each mode sit on its own map reached through the portals?
answers.answer: Keep the luxury mall lobby and VIP wing as one continuous shared space, with portals leading to separate runway-show maps for rounds.

answers.ask: Are the dressing booths private per-player instances, or physical rooms in the shared lobby that anyone can walk into?
answers.answer: Dressing booths are private per-player instances, so each player can customize outfits without others entering or seeing their booth.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D fashion game layout centered on a huge, continuous luxury fashion mall lobby. A spinning central runway anchors the main hall, surrounded by glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, portals to separate runway-show maps, a daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, and event stage. Connect a VIP wing to the shared mall through sparkling golden doors, containing a luxury boutique, VIP-only dressing booths, a private runway practice room, and chat lounge. Use private per-player dressing-booth instances with smart mirrors, makeup and hair stations, accessory organizers, and clothing display sections. Include a fashion magazine display area for winning outfits.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, with Party & Casual secondary for the recurring runway-show rounds. The dress-up and social-fashion experience owns the layout, using the Dress Up preset.

### Shape and preset
Use `stage-runway`, matching Dress Up: the shared luxury mall is organized around fashion presentation, a central runway, preparation spaces, and image-making venues. The prompt extends this preset into a continuous mall lobby and VIP wing, while runway rounds are reached through portals on separate maps.

### Config requirements
`social-hub` is visible geometry: the oversized main mall hall is a gathering space centered on the spinning runway. `vignette-photo` is visible geometry: provide the dedicated photo studio and polished fashion-magazine display as composed image locations. `teleporter-link` is both visible and invisible: clearly identifiable portals around the mall physically lead to separate runway-show maps, with linked destination markers placed after segmentation. Do not render the private per-player dressing-booth instances in the shared lobby image; they are separate private interiors containing smart mirrors, makeup and hair stations, accessory organizers, and clothing display sections.

### Layout components
The main, large enclosed luxury mall hall occupies the center, with the spinning central runway as its dominant circular focal object. Ring the hall with glowing waterfalls, glass elevators, giant digital billboards, the daily reward fountain, trading plaza, photo studio, event stage, fashion magazine display, and portal bank for runway-show maps. Use broad polished walkways around the runway to connect every venue without bottlenecks. Place the VIP wing directly off one side of the main hall behind sparkling golden doors; it is part of the same shared space and contains a luxury boutique, VIP-only dressing-booth access, a private runway practice room, and a chat lounge. The mall is fully enclosed by luxe glass, gold-trimmed walls, and a high ceiling; no exterior terrain is needed. Compose the view with the runway centered, the VIP doors legible to one side, and waterfalls, elevators, and billboards framing the depth of the hall.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the authoritative first render is an isometric fashion-mall scene, since the visual hierarchy and glamour of the central runway matter more than constrained traversal topology; project the top-down afterward.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large, driven by the huge shared mall, its many distinct venues, VIP wing, and separate portal destinations. Theme: luminous high-fashion luxury mall, glass, gold, animated digital signage, and glamorous editorial lighting. Use `P4` because runway-show rounds and each per-player dressing booth are separate maps or instances rather than coexisting areas of the shared mall.
